business_problem: Conestoga needed to expand and modernize its analytics foundation because growth in data volumes, suppliers, and customer interactions required more scalable decision support without disrupting existing reports or operations.
solution_summary: Conestoga first used IBM Netezza Performance Server and IBM Cognos Analytics to centralize reporting across marketing, sales, operations, manufacturing, and finance, then modernized that estate into IBM Netezza SaaS on AWS. Working with IBM and business partner DAI Source, the company lifted its on-premises analytics appliance into a fully managed cloud warehouse with like-for-like compatibility so the BI layer could be redirected without changing reports or dashboards. Cognos remained the reporting surface while Netezza continued to support large query volumes and multi-terabyte workloads. The new architecture preserved continuity for internal users, added cloud-native scalability, and created a path for future watsonx.data governance and lakehouse work. By retaining familiar analytics logic while moving the warehouse infrastructure to AWS, Conestoga reduced migration friction and kept data-driven decision support available to leadership during the transition.

solution_components.name: IBM Netezza Performance Server
solution_components.role: Served as the original analytics appliance used to store larger data volumes and process high daily query counts.

solution_components.name: IBM Netezza SaaS on AWS
solution_components.role: Provides the modern fully managed cloud data warehouse that replaced the on-premises appliance without changing the BI layer.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Automates business reporting and delivers decision-support dashboards and insights to leaders across the company.

data_flow: Data from marketing, sales, operations, manufacturing, and finance lands in Netezza, Cognos consumes the warehouse to run automated reports and dashboards, and the same BI flows continue after migration to the managed AWS-based Netezza SaaS environment.
business_outcome: Conestoga improved analytics scalability and continuity, preserved zero-disruption reporting during migration, and laid the groundwork for future AI and governance use cases.
metrics: 5,200+ reports run by Netezza and Cognos per day
1.2 TB of data and 10,000 daily queries supported by Netezza
architecture_clues: The migration was described as a straightforward lift and shift with no report or dashboard changes.
Netezza and Cognos now run as a cloud-based analytics foundation on AWS.
